An '''unidentified Nikto''' worked as a guard for the [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[Jib Kopatha]] on [[Void Station]] during the early parts of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a few months after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]] visited Void Station, in order to extract information from Kopatha about the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] whereabouts. The [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] claimed that gaining such information were very hard to find, which caused Vader to put pressure on him by using [[The Force/Legends|The Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends#Choking powers|choke]] him.

Kopatha's guards tried to intervene, charging towards Vader. The [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] was knocked unconscious, when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Telekinesis/Legends|threw]] him into a wall.
